clips.title: The story
paras: Rattling the Rattlecages is an early trial assigned by Shadow Priest Sarvis to newly awakened Forsaken in Deathknell. Tasked with destroying twelve Rattlecage Skeletons, fresh undead prove their resilience against the Scourge and demonstrate that they possess the willpower to defend their newly won freedom.

Having culled the mindless zombies stumbling through Deathknell, newly risen Forsaken are immediately pushed into a harsher trial. Shadow Priest Sarvis directs recruits to confront the Rattlecage Skeletons roaming the outskirts of the settlement. These animated bones lack any trace of sapience or self-control, yet they hit harder and fight with greater ferocity than the decaying corpses nearby. Surviving their clattering ambushes demonstrates that a new recruit will not falter when placed under immediate pressure.

To Sarvis and the leadership in Deathknell, culling the skeletons serves a dual purpose. It protects the fragile refuge from being overrun by the lingering grip of the Lich King while weeding out those recruits who cannot cut it. Those who fail or hesitate risk meeting the same fate as the mindless wretches wandering the woods. Overcoming the Rattlecages proves to Sarvis that the recruit possesses the mettle required to navigate a world that despises their very existence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances friend - now let's see you under pressure.

The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far. Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken. Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Those who dally in this task might as well end up wandering about aimlessly like our fallen brothers and sisters in the village. Let's hope you will fare better than them, yes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am finished with you, friend - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given. Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.
Take these and be on your way. You have much to accomplish, warlock.
